subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should editable composer dictation become a core Control UI feature through a Gateway/provider-backed `tools.media.audio` path?
rationale: The implementation choice affects core UI behavior, microphone privacy, provider routing, and a new authenticated Gateway method, which automation should not decide from source inspection alone.

options.title: Review Gateway-backed dictation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the candidate and require proof, accessibility, authorization, cleanup, and docs to pass before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader voice tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 so TTS, Talk, and batch dictation are designed together.

options.title: Decline core dictation for now
options.body: Close the feature direction and leave users on OS/browser dictation, file upload, or Talk until a plugin/API extension is explicitly prioritized.

recommendation.title: Review Gateway-backed dictation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the candidate and require proof, accessibility, authorization, cleanup, and docs to pass before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest feature-history signal from the prior Gateway-backed dictation implementation and adjacent Control UI voice work.
